subject: Intro call recap: FinTechCorp x Redwood - security, incident response & BCP
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechcorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-12 15:02 -0700
Subject: Intro call recap: FinTechCorp x Redwood - security & incident response

Jordan / team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning — helpful overview. A few follow-ups from our security and procurement teams so we can move to the vendor evaluation stage: 

1) SOC 2: can you confirm Redwood's current SOC 2 status and provide the latest report (scope and date)?
2) GDPR / HIPAA: do you support GDPR requirements and are BAAs available for HIPAA/ePHI workloads? Which deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private) are covered?
3) Incident response & breach notification: what are your timelines for identifying/confirming incidents and notifying customers? Do you have an IR playbook or post-incident report template we can review?
4) BCP/DR evidence: can you provide RTO/RPO targets and recent DR test evidence or summary?

We also have a short vendor security questionnaire attached to this thread — would Redwood be able to complete it within 7 business days? If helpful, we can schedule a focused session with your security contact to walk through answers.

Appreciate it — Alice
Alice Chen
Senior Security Manager, FinTechCorp

Attachment: FinTechCorp_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-12 18:30 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call recap: FinTechCorp x Redwood - security & incident response

Hi Alice — great to meet you earlier, and thanks for the clear follow-up. Quick answers and next steps below, and I've looped in Marissa and Rishi from our security team to supply documents and handle the questionnaire.

1) SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report (covering our hosted API + core control plane) with the most recent audit completed in Nov 2025. I'll attach the report and a short scope summary.

2) GDPR / HIPAA: We are GDPR-aligned across our hosted and Dedicated offerings; for HIPAA/ePHI we support BAAs for Dedicated and Private deployment options. We can provide a BAA template for your review and confirm which deployment options will be covered in the BAA.

3) Incident response & breach notification: Our policy is to notify impacted customers within 72 hours of confirming a notifiable personal data breach (aligned with GDPR guidance). For confirmed incidents affecting customer workloads or data we commit to an initial notification within 72 hours and a follow-up post-incident report within 10 business days where feasible. Incident response playbook attached.

4) BCP/DR: Summary attached — typical RTO is 4 hours for critical serving paths on Dedicated capacity; RPO is < 1 hour for customer KV caches where applicable. We include DR test summaries in the BCP package.

Questionnaire: happy to complete the FinTechCorp questionnaire. Marissa will coordinate — if you can grant access to the questionnaire portal or re-share the form, we can target 5–7 business days. We can also schedule a 30-minute review call.

Next steps: Marissa, Rishi — can you pick this up and share the SOC2 report, IR playbook, BCP summary, and confirm availability for a review call?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_report_2025.pdf; Incident_Response_Playbook_v2.pdf; BCP_DR_summary.pdf

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechcorp.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Bob Kim <bob.k@fintechcorp.com>, procurement@fintechcorp.com
Date: 2026-08-13 09:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call recap: FinTechCorp x Redwood - security & incident response

Jordan / Marissa / Rishi,

Thanks for the quick response and the attachments — we'll review the SOC2 and IR playbook today. A few clarifying Qs from our reviewers: 

- SOC2 scope: does it explicitly include the hosted API endpoints and telemetry/logging systems that would process our customer data?
- HIPAA / BAA: For Dedicated deployments, can Redwood sign a BAA that covers logging/monitoring data retained for troubleshooting?
- Incident timelines: if there is a confirmed incident that might impact FinTechCorp customers, does Redwood commit to the 72-hour timeline regardless of region (EU / US)?
- Questionnaire turnaround: 5 business days would be ideal for us; is that achievable?

Also, procurement requested we schedule a 30-minute walkthrough next week (we're looking at Tue 8/18 or Wed 8/19). Please let us know availability.

Best,
Alice

Attachment: FinTechCorp_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (re-attached)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@fintechcorp.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-13 10:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro call recap: FinTechCorp x Redwood - security & incident response

Hi Alice — thanks for the questions. Quick clarifications inline below and next actions at the bottom.

- SOC 2 scope: The attached SOC 2 Type II report covers our hosted API, authentication, telemetry ingestion, and control plane. Workloads that customers host in Dedicated or Private are out-of-scope for the hosted SOC report; however, we provide configuration and controls guidance for Dedicated/Private. (See SOC2_scope_notes in the attached PDF.)

- HIPAA / BAA: We can execute a BAA for Dedicated and Private deployments. The BAA can cover logging/monitoring data if that is within the defined scope; we'll share a standard BAA template and mark any clauses that typically require negotiation. For hosted shared tenants, BAAs are not available — Dedicated/Private required for ePHI.

- Incident timelines: Our operational practice is to treat notification commitments consistently across regions. For suspected personal data breaches, we notify customers within 72 hours of confirming a notifiable breach, and we provide an initial incident classification on detection where possible. Regulatory notification obligations remain the customer's responsibility, and we will coordinate and provide the data necessary for their filings.

- Questionnaire turnaround: 5 business days is reasonable. To meet that timeline, please confirm whether you prefer us to upload answers directly into your questionnaire portal (we can request access) or if you want a completed PDF returned.

Next actions:
- I'll upload the SOC2 scope notes, IR playbook, and BCP summary to our secure portal: https://security.redwood-inference.com/portal/fintechcorp (link below).
- Jordan: I'll own the questionnaire; Alice, can you grant portal access or confirm the preferred return format?
- Proposed review call: Tue 2026-08-18 10:00 PT — tentatively hold. We'll send a calendar invite once the time is confirmed.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_scope_notes.pdf; Incident_Response_Playbook_v2.pdf; BCP_DR_summary.pdf
